name: Anti-Demon Club
source:
The Anti-Demon Club is a Visual Novel set in a familiar Japanese High School setting, in which a young lady named Asagi and her friends form a club to hunt the strange and supernatural. You, Kyosuke, have to deal with their bullshit.

[From [url=https://frocto.itch.io/anti-demon-club]Itch.io[/url]]
